dos.text: Set deck to the id of a named-deck that shares the same root node as the moz-segmented-control, setupDeckListener() only calls getRootNode().querySelector(), so a deck living in a different shadow root silently fails to wire up with no error.

donts.text: Don't expect items to get role="tab" just because the control looks like a tab switcher, getChildRole() only returns "tab" when a deck attribute is actually set; without it items stay role="radio" regardless of visual usage.

Don't rely on a native input/change event.target being an <input>, moz-segmented-control-item isn't a real form input, handleClick() manually dispatches synthetic bubbling input and change events from the button element itself.
